summary: Post-fork regression verification (backend + frontend). All fork-critical concerns pass: (a) backend base URL https://panic-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api reachable, (b) guest auth returns 200 with token, (c) leaderboard (global + friends, season + alltime) returns sorted rows with my_rank, (d) daily challenges GET returns 3 deterministic items and claim rules (404 unknown / 400 incomplete) enforced, (e) match join/leave + challenge progress accrual works, (f) WebSocket transport /api/match/{id}/ws rejects bad tokens (close 4401) and pushes a personalised state frame for valid tokens — NO fork-related WS regression. Frontend Expo web preview loads, entry screen renders (input-username + auth-submit), auth -> menu shows daily reward/challenges/rank/PRESS/FIND MATCH + tab bar, FIND MATCH -> lobby -> active phase in ~6.5s, panic-button taps register (3 kills, danger 5%->6%, elimination feed populated with feed items and self entries in red). No red-screen errors, only harmless font sfntVersion warnings on the web preview asset endpoint (pre-existing across all iterations).
action_items: OPTIONAL housekeeping — 4 stale tests in older suites reflect product evolution, not regressions, and can be refreshed when convenient: (1) tests/test_panic_button.py::TestAbilities::test_list asserts len==4 but there are now 9 abilities. (2) tests/test_social_features.py::TestCoLobby::test_two_guests_share_match keys off state['humans'] which no longer exists (state exposes players_total/players_alive). (3) tests/test_social_features.py::TestResultsAndPersistence::test_results_shape_after_leave and (4) tests/test_rewarded_ads.py::TestAdsRegression::test_match_results_still_render both poll state right after /match/leave and expect 'results' immediately — but leaving during active phase only marks the player eliminated; results appear only when the match ends (99 bots keep playing). They need to either wait for phase==ended or read 'my_result' (which IS present) instead of 'results'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 iter10 fork-critical) + 33/37 across broader legacy suites (4 stale-test failures, no app regressions)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (entry -> auth -> menu -> lobby -> active -> press flow)
